# IP-04 Brief — End-to-End Plan Synthesis

## Objective

Synthesize the accepted task reports into the canonical CR-012 / FEAT34 end-to-end implementation plan.

## Inputs

- Accepted IP-01, IP-02, and IP-03 reports and reviews.
- All source-of-truth documents referenced by those reports.

## Output

Write only `docs/implementation-plan.md`. Do not modify the frontend execution plan, ledger, graph, source docs, code, schema, generated artifacts, or Git state.

## Required document sections

1. YAML document control and warning banner.
2. Executive summary and readiness verdict.
3. Scope, assumptions, non-goals, and source authority.
4. Requirements and traceability baseline.
5. Architecture/work-package decomposition with complexity scores.
6. Dependency DAG, critical path, and parallel lanes.
7. Team/capacity model and delivery roadmap.
8. First-30-percent sprint plan and later phase plan.
9. Test, security, accessibility, observability, deployment, rollback, and release gates.
10. Risk register and decision/blocker ledger.
11. Definition of Done and requirement-to-evidence matrix.
12. Version history.

The plan must be conditional and must not claim implementation readiness while the preflight report is critical or MSP/contract gates remain open.
